claims.value: Formerly owned by Giulio de' Medici (Pope Clement VII)
claims.statement: The museum text says the Madonna was formerly owned by Giulio de' Medici, later Clement VII. This identification probably rests on Vasari's description of a Madonna with a vase of flowers owned by Clement VII; it is an identification, not a documented chain.
